top_signals.title: Iraq Rejects OPEC+ Assessment of Its Oil Production Capacity
top_signals.summary: Iraq has rejected an assessment of its oil production capacity that was commissioned by OPEC+, according to people familiar with the matter, setting up a potential clash at this weekend’s key meeting on production targets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Port Houston Shares Ship Channel Monthly Trade, Market Report
top_signals.summary: Trade activity across the Houston Ship Channel region continued to grow, reinforcing the waterway's role in supporting American industries, jobs, and economic activity. Foreign tonnage increased 15% year to date through September, reaching 200.2 million tons, driven by a 20% rise in exports.
